page.overview:
Who is Air Force colonel?

The unnamed Air Force colonel works at the Pentagon.

Lisa Simpson wants to buy Sane Planning, Sensible Tomorrow by Al Gore and the cashier is ringing it through the barcode scanner at bookstore sending an electronic message though a switching station and then a satellite in orbit to the Pentagon where the Air Force colonel grabs the print-out and rushes off to the White House. He bursts through the doors into then Vice President Al Gore's office and breathlessly exclaims, "Mr. Vice President! Someone finally bought a copy of your book!"
